categories.name: TextField/EditText Properties and Formatting
categories.description: Needs comprehensive TextField/EditText property support including: TextFormat object (align, font, size, color, bold, italic, underline, leading, margins, indent, tabStops, letterSpacing, bullet), HTML text round-trip (htmlText property with tag parsing/generation), text selection and caret positioning, scroll/hscroll/maxscroll properties, autoSize behavior, input text handling (restrict, password, maxChars), TextSnapshot for read-only text access, and programmatic focus control.

sub_categories.name: HTML text
sub_categories.note: Needs HTML parsing/generation in htmlText property

sub_categories.name: Input/Focus
sub_categories.note: Text input, focus, and selection handling

sub_categories.name: Layout/Formatting
sub_categories.note: Autosize, scroll, width/height, font metrics, etc.

categories.name: XML/XMLNode
categories.description: Needs full XML DOM implementation. The XML class requires: constructor (new XML / new XML(string)), parseXML(), toString(), createElement(), createTextNode(), appendChild(), insertBefore(), removeNode(), cloneNode(), hasChildNodes(). XMLNode properties: childNodes, firstChild, lastChild, previousSibling, nextSibling, parentNode, nodeType, nodeName, nodeValue, attributes. Also needs: ignoreWhite property, idMap, xmlDecl, docTypeDecl, CDATA handling, XML escaping/unescaping.

sub_categories.name: Core XML DOM
sub_categories.note: Core XML parsing, manipulation, and serialization

categories.name: LoadMovie/LoadVariables/MovieClipLoader
categories.description: Needs runtime SWF/image loading capability. loadMovie() loads external SWF files into movie clip targets. loadMovieNum() loads into _levels. loadVariables()/loadVariablesNum() loads URL-encoded variable data. MovieClipLoader is the AS2 event-based loader with onLoadStart/onLoadComplete/onLoadInit/onLoadError callbacks and getProgress(). These all fundamentally require network/file loading which may not be feasible in the recompiler's trace-only mode.

categories.name: MovieClip Methods and Properties
categories.description: Needs MovieClip method implementations beyond basic timeline control. Key methods: getBounds()/getRect(), hitTest(), createTextField(), getInstanceAtDepth(), depth methods (getDepth, getNextHighestDepth, swapDepths), setMask(), _lockroot, state properties (_currentframe, _totalframes, _framesloaded, _url, _quality, blendMode), focusEnabled, init object in attachMovie.

categories.name: Mouse/Focus/Input Events
categories.description: Needs simulated mouse/keyboard event dispatch for trace-only testing. Tests expect synthetic input events (mouse click, move, key press) to trigger onPress, onRelease, onRollOver, onRollOut, onMouseDown, onMouseUp, etc. callbacks. Also needs focus management (Selection.setFocus, moveFocus, focus rectangle drawing), and Mouse.addListener()/Mouse.removeListener() for global mouse events.

categories.name: Button Behavior and Events
categories.description: Needs button event handling in trace mode. Tests need: button key events (onKeyDown/onKeyUp on buttons), button_goto (gotoAndStop from button actions), button display ordering, button property access (special cases for _name, _target, etc.), SWF5/SWF6 version-specific button behavior, and handling of buttons after their parent clip is removed.

categories.name: Tab Ordering and Focus Navigation
categories.description: Needs tab/focus navigation system. Automatic tab ordering sorts by position (top-to-bottom, left-to-right). Custom tab ordering uses tabIndex property. Tests check tabEnabled, tabIndex, tabChildren properties on MovieClips and Buttons. Requires synthetic Tab key press simulation.

categories.name: String Methods and String Paths
categories.description: Two sub-features: (1) String methods: String.prototype methods like charAt, charCodeAt, indexOf, etc. (2) String paths: Flash's path-based variable resolution using slash syntax (e.g., _root/clip:variable), eval() for dynamic path resolution, and variable aliasing through paths.

sub_categories.name: String paths
sub_categories.note: Path-based variable resolution using slash syntax

categories.name: Global Built-in Functions and Objects
categories.description: Tests that enumerate all global variables and check which built-in classes/functions exist per SWF version. Many failures are because built-in classes (XML, Date, Color, Sound, etc.) are not registered as globals. Fixing these tests requires implementing all the other missing features AND registering their constructors on _global.

categories.name: Sound
categories.description: Needs Sound object implementation for trace mode. Constructor: new Sound(target). Methods: start(), stop(), attachSound(), loadSound(), getVolume(), setVolume(), getPan(), setPan(), getTransform(), setTransform(), getBytesLoaded(), getBytesTotal(). Properties: duration, position, id3.

categories.name: BitmapData
categories.description: Needs flash.display.BitmapData class implementation. Methods needed: compare(), copyPixels(), hitTest(), threshold(), noise(). The bitmap_data test is the main constructor/property test.

categories.name: FileReference
categories.description: Needs flash.net.FileReference class. Browse, download, and upload operations with event callbacks. Requires file system and network access -- likely not implementable in trace-only mode.

categories.name: OOP / Super / Extends / Interfaces
categories.description: Needs proper super keyword support in AS2 classes and interface/implements support. Tests check: super in constructors, super in methods, super with manual prototype chains, extending native types (Array, String, etc.), and edge cases where super interacts with this binding.

categories.name: RegisterClass and Export/Registration
categories.description: Needs Object.registerClass() implementation for linking AS2 classes to library symbols. When a movie clip with a registered class is instantiated, the class constructor should be called and this should be the clip instance.

categories.name: Stage Object Properties
categories.description: Needs Stage object as a special global with properties: width, height, scaleMode, displayState, align, showMenu, quality.

categories.name: SWF Version-Specific Behavior
categories.description: Tests that verify version-dependent behavior differences: case sensitivity (SWF6 insensitive, SWF7+ sensitive), cross-version function calls between loaded movies, SWF5 closure behavior, string-as-boolean coercion, and SWF4 type coercion.

categories.name: TellTarget / Target Path Resolution
categories.description: Needs proper tellTarget (ActionSetTarget/ActionSetTarget2) implementation with correct scope resolution. When targeting a clip, variable reads should resolve against target scope, and writes should set properties on the target.

categories.name: Unload / UnloadMovie
categories.description: Needs proper unload behavior. When a movie clip is unloaded: onUnload event fires, clip becomes inaccessible by name but retains its depth slot, nested children are recursively unloaded.

categories.name: Clone/Duplicate MovieClip
categories.description: Needs duplicateMovieClip() and MovieClip.duplicateMovieClip() implementation. Cloning should copy the clip's display list, including text fields.

categories.name: Native Object/Function Introspection
categories.description: Tests that check behavior of native (built-in) objects and functions. Meta-tests that effectively require all built-in classes to be implemented.

categories.name: Prototype Chain and Object Properties
categories.description: Needs correct __proto__ chain traversal, isPrototypeOf(), for-in enumeration of prototype properties, and property flags (DontEnum, DontDelete, ReadOnly).

categories.name: Math Object
categories.description: Needs Math object with all standard methods. math_swf6/7/8 are comprehensive tests of every Math method.

categories.name: NetConnection/NetStream
categories.description: Needs NetConnection and NetStream classes for FLV video playback. Requires network and media capabilities -- likely not implementable in trace-only mode.

categories.name: Object.watch
categories.description: Needs Object.prototype.watch() and Object.prototype.unwatch() methods. watch() registers a callback that's invoked when a property is set.

categories.name: Color Object
categories.description: Needs new Color(target) constructor with methods: getRGB(), setRGB(), getTransform(), setTransform(). The Color object controls color transformation on a movie clip target. The transform test needs flash.geom.Transform.

categories.name: Drag and Drop
categories.description: Needs startDrag()/stopDrag() implementation with simulated mouse movement for trace testing.

categories.name: Enumeration (for-in)
categories.description: Needs correct for-in enumeration order. ActionScript enumerates own properties in reverse insertion order, then walks the prototype chain.

categories.name: ExternalInterface
categories.description: Needs ExternalInterface class for JavaScript bridge. ExternalInterface.call() invokes JavaScript functions, ExternalInterface.addCallback() registers AS functions callable from JS. Requires browser context -- likely not implementable in trace-only mode.

categories.name: Geometry Classes: Point, Rectangle, Matrix
categories.description: Needs flash.geom.Point, flash.geom.Rectangle, and flash.geom.Matrix class implementations. These are pure math/data classes with constructors and methods.

categories.name: PrintJob
categories.description: Needs PrintJob class constructor and properties. Likely just needs the constructor registered; actual printing functionality not needed for trace tests.

categories.name: Timer / setInterval
categories.description: Needs setInterval()/clearInterval() and setTimeout()/clearTimeout() implementation. Requires a timer scheduling system in the runtime.

categories.name: StyleSheet
categories.description: Needs flash.text.StyleSheet class for CSS-style text formatting. StyleSheet.parseCSS() parses CSS text, StyleSheet.transform() transforms TextFormat objects.

categories.name: Bitmap Filters
categories.description: Needs flash.filters package classes: BlurFilter, DropShadowFilter, GlowFilter, BevelFilter, etc.

categories.name: Clip Events (onLoad, onEnterFrame, etc.)
categories.description: Needs proper MovieClip event dispatching: onLoad, onUnload, onEnterFrame, onClipEvent(initialize), onClipEvent(construct), and correct propagation order.

categories.name: ContextMenu
categories.description: Needs ContextMenu and ContextMenuItem classes. Likely just needs the class constructors registered.

categories.name: Form Loading / URL Encoding
categories.description: Tests URL-encoded form data loading with various character encodings. Requires network loading -- not implementable in trace-only mode.

categories.name: Key/Input Events
categories.description: Needs Key object with isToggled() for checking Caps Lock/Num Lock state, and dead key input handling for international keyboards. Requires keyboard event simulation.

categories.name: LocalConnection
categories.description: Needs LocalConnection class for inter-SWF communication. Constructor, connect(), send(), close(), domain property.

categories.name: Parsing Functions (parseInt/parseFloat)
categories.description: Needs correct parseInt() and parseFloat() global functions with edge case handling.

categories.name: Selection Object
categories.description: Needs Selection object with methods: getBeginIndex(), getEndIndex(), getCaretIndex(), getFocus(), setFocus(), setSelection().

categories.name: With Statement Scope
categories.description: Needs correct with statement scope chain behavior.

categories.name: Date Class
categories.description: Needs Date class constructor and all methods. The single test is huge (6335 expected lines) and partially passing, suggesting a Date implementation exists but has edge case bugs.

categories.name: Try/Catch/Finally
categories.description: Try/catch/finally exists (try_finally_simple passes). This test likely hits an edge case that causes an infinite loop.

categories.name: MovieClip Dynamic Creation / Lifecycle
categories.description: Tests for dynamic clip creation (attachMovie, createEmptyMovieClip), symbol export/import, DoInitAction execution, construction events, display list ordering, and PlaceObject depth conflict handling.

categories.name: Function Behavior and Scope
categories.description: Tests for function scope chains, closures (SWF6+), Function() constructor, function.apply()/call(), base clip resolution for functions, DefineFunction2 suppress/preload flags, and the Call action (frame call).

categories.name: Object System
categories.description: Tests for addProperty (virtual getters/setters), ASSetPropFlags (property flags), boxed primitives (new Number/String/Boolean), InitObject property order, __resolve handler, and valueOf/toString coercion.

categories.name: Clip Removal and Scope After Removal
categories.description: Tests for removeMovieClip behavior, script halting when base clip is removed, scope resolution after clip removal, and depth management during timeline rewind.

categories.name: Path Resolution
categories.description: Tests for variable path resolution via slash syntax (/clip1/clip2:var), named shape access, property access with invalid base clips, and cross-movie _root resolution.

categories.name: Type Coercion and Global Functions
categories.description: Tests for isFinite() function, mutable this binding, primitive type constructors as globals (Number, String, Boolean), and object coercion with monkey-patched constructors.

categories.name: Array Methods
categories.description: Tests for calling methods stored in arrays, Array prototype modification, and Array.sort() with random comparator.

categories.name: Stage/Frame Properties
categories.description: Tests for frame bounds translation and shape properties (_x, _y, _width, _height) with translated stage coordinates.

categories.name: Issue Regression Tests
categories.description: Bug-specific regression tests from the Ruffle project.

categories.name: AsBroadcaster / ASnative / Miscellaneous Built-ins
categories.description: AsBroadcaster (addListener/removeListener/broadcastMessage), asfunction HTML link protocol, ASnative/ASnew for native function access, arguments object, instanceof coercions, and miscellaneous built-in behaviors.

categories.name: LoadVars and Network
categories.description: LoadVars class (load, send, sendAndLoad methods). Both require network access.

categories.name: Hit Testing
categories.description: Hit testing with lockroot, morph shapes, winding rules, and text click blocking.

categories.name: Cross-Movie / Level / Root
categories.description: Tests for multi-level movie management (_level0, _level1), _lockroot behavior, _root vs _global vs _parent resolution, and root onLoad event.

categories.name: Sandbox/Security
categories.description: System.security.sandboxType returns different values per sandbox mode. Would need per-test sandbox configuration.

categories.name: Frame Navigation
categories.description: Frame navigation methods beyond basic gotoAndStop/gotoAndPlay. Edge case handling for out-of-range frames, NaN, negative values, and label resolution.

categories.name: Scope and Variable Resolution
categories.description: DefineLocal/DefineLocal2 actions for local variable declaration in functions.

categories.name: This Scoping
categories.description: this binding behavior in different contexts: with blocks, nested clips, and method calls.

categories.name: Miscellaneous Remaining
categories.description: Various uncategorized tests: getBytesLoaded/getBytesTotal, getURL action, TextFormat.getTextExtent, device font spacing, localToGlobal/globalToLocal, toString/valueOf coercion, Array.sort edge cases.

near_passing_notes.attach_movie: attachMovie with init object or invalid IDs
near_passing_notes.mutable_this: Mutable this binding in nested functions

crash_notes.swf4_actions_coercion_order: SWF4 type coercion during action execution
